titles.en: Stele of the Yan Family Shrine

attribution.name: 颜真卿
attribution.note: The museum states that Yan Zhenqing composed and wrote the text for his father 颜惟贞; the stele is his latest surviving work.
attribution.noteZh: 馆方记颜真卿为其父颜惟贞撰文并书；此碑为其现存最晚之作。

attribution.name: 李阳冰
attribution.note: The seal-script heading 颜氏家庙之碑 is credited to Li Yangbing; the heading-writer is not the calligrapher of the body.
attribution.noteZh: 篆额「颜氏家庙之碑」出李阳冰之手；书额者非碑文书者。

background: Yan Zhenqing made this shrine stele for his father Yan Weizhen in 780, three years before his death. Both faces carry 24 lines of 47 characters; each side carries 6 lines of 52. The stone is 338 cm high with a chi-dragon head and a turtle base. Having fallen in the fields during the disorders of the late Tang, it was re-erected in the prefectural Confucian temple in 982, and it is among the earliest steles moved to the site of the present Beilin.
backgroundZh: 颜真卿于建中元年（780）为其父颜惟贞立此家庙碑，三年后遇害。碑阳、碑阴各二十四行、行四十七字，两侧各六行、行五十二字；螭首龟趺，高三百三十八厘米。唐室离乱后碑仆于郊野，北宋太平兴国七年（982）移入府城文庙重立，为后来移入今碑林最早的碑石之一。

review.note: Draft record from the Xi'an Beilin object entry read on 2026-11-23. That page did not respond to a second request later the same day, so the wording is recorded but not re-verified; the stone was not examined.
review.noteZh: 草稿记录，依据 2026-11-23 阅读的西安碑林条目整理。该页当日稍后再次请求未通，故所记文字未得复核；未核对原石。

notes: The museum gives the height as 338 cm and does not give width or thickness, so only the height is recorded.
The 982 date is the re-erection recorded in the inscription's own Song colophon, as summarised by the museum; it is not the date of the stele.
notesZh: 馆方只记高三百三十八厘米，未记宽厚，故仅录高度。
982 年为碑阳宋人题记所记重立之年，据馆方概述；非立碑之年。
